sources.entry: Unused - Mac app for checking Xcode projects for unused resources.

summary.one_liner: Unused is a Mac app that scans Xcode projects to find image resources that are not referenced, so you can trim app bundle size.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Mac utility that checks Xcode projects for image resources that are not used. Its stated purpose is to help reduce app bundle size by listing unused images. The README is very short and says it is version 1.0, created by Jeff Hodnett. It does not describe the interface, how the scan works, or which project formats are supported beyond Xcode. A link to full project info is referenced but not included in the README text.
use_cases: find unused images in an Xcode project
reduce iOS or macOS app bundle size
notable: Targets unused image resources specifically in Xcode projects
Aimed at shrinking app bundle size
caveats: README is very brief and gives no installation or usage steps
No details on supported Xcode versions or project types
Only image resources are mentioned as scanned
